summary: Phase 2 end-to-end tested. Backend: 11/11 new pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_phase2.py covering compliance (Class A + rating_gotcha + overweight warning), rate math (450mi/$4/10mpg/$1350 → total ~265.73, profit ~1084, margin ~80%), driver rate 403 role gate, securement (steel 9000/20ft → 3× chains WLL 19,800), full trip flow (start/duty/state-miles/stop with rig auto-fill to Big Blue and total_miles=150), active-rig picker persistence + driver 403, and sample data presence (5 doc categories + Big Blue rig). Frontend (390x844 mobile): owner login OK, dashboard shows Manage Drivers, quick-rate/compliance/securement; Compliance UI with Big Blue selected returns 'CDL Class A required' card, USDOT/Medical/HOS/CDL/Consortium REQUIRED chips render, rating-gotcha summary '37,000 lb sets the requirement' is displayed, cargo=22000 triggers trailer capacity warning; Rate tab produces PROFIT card 80%; Securement Steel/Metal + 20ft renders '3 × 3/8" Grade 70 chain w/ binder' with checkable list; owner set-active-rig-<i> button toggles star state and PUT /api/settings/active-rig persists. Driver: no Rate tab in Tools, no Manage Drivers or quick-rate on dashboard (quick-trip shown instead), trip start auto-fills to Big Blue, duty toggling works, state-miles TX:120 records, end trip creates completed history entry with 150 mi; dashboard active-trip banner visible while trip is running. Phase 1 regression suite (16/16) unchanged and still passes.

issues: Rig auto-selects rigs[0] on load. On this DB rigs[0] is the leftover Phase-1 'UI TEST Rig' (no GCWR) which produces a misleading 'CMV — no CDL' result if the user does not manually pick 'Big Blue'. Consider defaulting to the owner's active_rig_id (same field used by Weigh Station) or to the driver's assigned rig.

action_items: Optional: default Compliance rig dropdown to user's active_rig_id (owner) / assigned_rig_id (driver) rather than rigs[0], so demo lands on Big Blue instead of the Phase-1 leftover rig.
Optional cleanup: leftover Phase-1 'UI TEST Rig' and 'DOT UI Test' document remain in Mongo from iteration 1.
Cosmetic: leftover a11y warning from Phase 1 (Dialog missing DialogDescription) still applies to Rigs/Documents add dialogs.
critical_code_review_comments: resolve_user_rig() correctly honors owner.active_rig_id; but /api/compliance and /api/securement never call it — they only accept an explicit rig_id / cargo weight, so users must pick the rig each time. Wiring the UI default to active_rig_id would remove the 'wrong rig auto-selected' foot-gun.
server.py weigh_station() lines 297-303: it computes `rig` via the old if/elif/else block then immediately re-assigns via `rig = await resolve_user_rig(user)`. Dead code — remove the first block.

POST /api/trips/start returns 400 if an active trip already exists (good), but /api/trips/active returns {} rather than 404/null when none — the frontend copes but this is a slightly awkward API contract.
trip_state_miles(): mutating the fetched state_miles list then $set-ing it is fine for single-user but has a race under concurrent writes; use $inc on a specific array element or a positional update.
rate() computes cost_per_mile at 2 decimal places, then the test expects ~0.59 — fine, but Python rounding can be off by 0.01; test uses tolerance so OK.
Frontend Tools.js Compliance auto-picks rigs[0]; better UX to pre-select active/assigned rig from /auth/me.
server.py mixes sync `requests` in async handlers (put_object/get_object) — unchanged from Phase 1, still worth migrating to httpx.AsyncClient.
seed_data_creation: None new. Phase-1 leftover 'UI TEST Rig' and 'DOT UI Test' document still in DB. Phase-2 tests self-clean their trips and any dynamic drivers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 regression: /app/backend/tests/test_phase2.py (11 tests, JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/phase2_results.xml). All Phase 2 features verified — Compliance (rating gotcha, Class A vs B, overweight warning), Rate calc + owner-only 403 gate, Securement (chains vs straps, 50% WLL rule, length-based min count), Trip flow (start auto-fills rig, duty toggle, state-miles accumulate, stop computes total_miles, active-trip banner on dashboard), active-rig picker on /api/settings/active-rig. One UX note: Tools › Compliance auto-selects rigs[0] which on current DB is a leftover Phase-1 'UI TEST Rig' — tests explicitly pick 'Big Blue' from the dropdown to exercise the GCWR 37,000 scenario. Phase 3/4 (POD/invoice, maintenance, expenses, AI assistant) still not built — do not test them.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Only a UX rough edge: Tools › Compliance defaults to rigs[0] instead of the owner's active_rig_id, which surfaces the Phase-1 leftover 'UI TEST Rig' first on this DB and hides the GCWR-37,000 'Big Blue' rating-gotcha scenario until the user manually picks it. Recommend defaulting the dropdown to the same rig that powers Weigh Station Mode.
